steps.title: What is a bonus?
steps.content: This tour shows how bonuses work on a gift. Bonuses live on the item itself and only apply while that gift is active.

steps.title: Example sheet
steps.content: An example Werewolf sheet is created for the tour. Open it to continue.

steps.title: Werewolf sheet
steps.content: Bonuses can belong to powers, traits, and other items. This tour uses the Rank 1 gift Persuasion as the example.

steps.title: Unlock sheet
steps.content: Unlock the sheet so you can open and edit items.

steps.title: Gifts
steps.content: Open the Gifts tab. Gifts are listed by rank; Persuasion is under Rank 1.

steps.title: Open Persuasion
steps.content: Open the gift (edit icon once unlocked). Click Next and the tour opens Persuasion for you.

steps.title: Gift item sheet
steps.content: This is the Persuasion gift sheet. The Bonuses section is further down on this window.

steps.title: Bonuses
steps.content: Persuasion already has three difficulty bonuses (Charisma, Manipulation, and Appearance). Use + to add more, the pen to edit, or trash to remove.

steps.title: Add a bonus
steps.content: Click + to create a new bonus on this gift. You can also drag a Bonus item from a compendium onto this section.

steps.title: Close the gift
steps.content: Close the item sheet when you are done. Changes are already saved. Click Next to close it.

steps.title: Activate the gift
steps.content: Tick the gift active. Its bonuses only count while the gift is active — deactivate it and they stop applying. That ends this tour.
